records.text: An Epstein document's name-search entry for Lynn Forester, also known as Lady de Rothschild, listed her work affiliation as president of The Corcoran Group.
records.speaker: TikTok Creator (Ep ti5Fxrvegno; name unverified)

appearances.snippet: Now, in this Epstein document that's doing an official name search, an alias for Lynn Forester, a.k.a. Lady de Rothschild, it states that under her work affiliations she is the Corcoran Group, Inc. president. And it even shows her email which is redacted.

verification.notes: The DOJ-released CLEAR background report identified as EFTA01654681 lists Corcoran Group among Lynn Forester's work affiliations, and analysis of the exact report records the Corcoran Group Inc. president entry. This verifies what the document lists, not that Forester actually held that office; Corcoran's own history identifies Pamela Liebman as CEO from 2000.

records.text: Owens said Epstein's emails stated that Lynn Forester de Rothschild established the Corcoran Group, under which Erika Kirk held a real-estate license, while Owens could find only two listings associated with Erika.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The consistent Rothschild connections in Erika (Erika Kirk)'s life, whether it's through the Corcoran Group, which we had already showed you, established according to Jeffrey Epstein's emails by Lynn Forester de Rothschild. ... which is where Erika gets her real estate license under. And yet, despite that, we only ever can find two listings that have ever gone up under Erika Frantzve.

verification.notes: Current real-estate profiles support that Erika Frantzve was associated with the Corcoran Group and show few or no publicly recorded listings. However, Corcorans own corporate history says Barbara Corcoran founded the company in 1973, directly contradicting the claim that Lynn Forester de Rothschild established it. Because the statement combines a false founding claim with a supported brokerage affiliation and an uncertain listing count, it is mixed.
